purpose: Freeze the source authority, semantic boundary, deterministic output rules, MVP entity scope, and fail-closed policies for the ConfigData Lookup Index before any index materialization begins.

authority.rawSourceRole: authoritative source for explicit ConfigData fields and direct ID references only
authority.canonicalSourceRole: existing FINAL_FROZEN / PASS_ACCEPTED generated consumers and frozen relation artifacts remain authoritative for project-level canonical semantics
authority.lookupIndexRole: derived read-optimization layer only; it does not own or redefine canonical semantics

sourcePriority: existing FINAL_FROZEN / PASS_ACCEPTED canonical consumer for already-resolved project semantics
existing generated checkpoint or lightweight derived artifact when it already answers the lookup
broader raw ConfigData scan only when no smaller authoritative source can answer the question

rawLookupMayExpose: explicit direct ID references present in the source record
source locator metadata needed to retrieve the record
canonicalLookupMayExpose: provenance path to the frozen artifact

indexPolicy.primaryJoinKeyPolicy: Use explicit source IDs and approved frozen canonical IDs only.

forbiddenOperations: recompute FINAL_FROZEN Hero-Soldier membership from raw ConfigData
recompute frozen Hero-Skin ownership or source order from raw ConfigData
recompute frozen Banner identity, grouping, Hero relations, or recurrence semantics
silent patching of missing canonical pairs or IDs
treat every numeric field as an ID reference
promote a raw direct reference into a project-level canonical relation without an approved semantic contract

reverseReferencePolicy.note: Reverse references must be generated only from explicitly approved reference-field schemas.

sourceFreshnessMetadata: source content hash or repository commit when available

requiredChecks: all four MVP source files exist
all four MVP entities use ID as the primary key
raw and canonical result classes are explicitly separated
lookup layer is declared non-authoritative for canonical semantics
forbidden inference and recomputation policies are present
Stage 1 output paths are unique and rooted under data/index

outOfScope: incremental rebuild or dependency impact analysis

nextStage.goal: Materialize minimal deterministic ID lookup indexes for Hero, Soldier, Skill, and Equipment without duplicating full ConfigData blobs or creating new semantic relations.
